name: Grand Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel & Residences Emirates Pearl
positioning: Grand Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel & Residences, a city hotel on Corniche Road in Abu Dhabi's West Corniche, with Club rooms that open onto balconies over the Arabian Gulf or the Presidential Palace
best_for: Travelers who want a balcony room with Arabian Gulf or Presidential Palace views
Guests who value club lounge access with breakfast and evening drinks

facts.text: The hotel is on Corniche Road in the West Corniche area of Abu Dhabi.
The King Club Access room with balcony measures 42 square meters.
Grand Club access includes all-day tea and coffee, plus evening cocktails, beverages, appetizers and canapes.
The King Club Access room has a Nespresso coffee maker.
The King Club Access room comes with plush robes and slippers.
A crib is available on request in the King Club Access room.
The King Club Access room has Hyatt In Room Entertainment (Staycast).
The King Club Access room has individual climate control.

highlights.text: The King Club Access room's private balcony overlooks the Arabian Gulf or the Presidential Palace.
The King Club Access room with balcony has floor-to-ceiling windows leading onto a private balcony.
Club Access room guests get Grand Club access, including complimentary breakfast served at Sahha.

considerations.text: The balcony view in the King Club Access room varies: it faces either the Arabian Gulf or the Presidential Palace.
Grand Club access, with its complimentary breakfast at Sahha, comes with the Club Access room category.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
